source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chemical nature of hormones (PDF 57-59).

blocks.text: Hormones ko unki chemical nature (kimiyai banawat) ke lehaz se groups mein baanta jata hai. Kitab kehti hai 'teen' bare groups hain, lekin aage chaar groups batati hai: peptide aur protein, glycoprotein, amino acid derivatives aur steroid hormones.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke hormones ke 'three main chemical categories' (teen bare kimiyai groups) hain, magar foran baad chaar groups bayan karti hai. Sahi yeh hai ke yahan hormones ke chaar bare kimiyai groups hain: (1) peptide aur protein, (2) glycoprotein, (3) amino acid derivatives, (4) steroid hormones.
